Title: Plaintext Password Hash Login Bypass
StepsToReproduce: 1. Find user in database. 2. Post hash to /api/v1/auth/login as password.
RootCause: Legacy raw string comparison check allows hash matching
Remediation: Remove '&& password !== user.passwordHash' check; enforce strict bcrypt comparison

Title: Zero Auth Guard Enforcement Across All APIs
StepsToReproduce: Send unauthenticated GET request to /api/v1/agents or /api/v1/customers.
RootCause: AuthGuard returns mock true and is never applied via APP_GUARD or UseGuards
Remediation: Implement real JWT verification and bind AuthGuard globally in AppModule

Title: Unauthenticated IDOR Access to Call Recordings
StepsToReproduce: Send GET request to /telephony/calls/{callId}/recording with no credentials.
ActualResult: 302 Redirect to signed Supabase audio URL
RootCause: Endpoint contains zero auth or role check and directly redirects to storage URL
Remediation: Apply supervisor/admin RBAC guard and verify tenant ownership before issuing signed URL

Title: Cleartext Secrets and Cloud Keys in Repository
ExpectedResult: Secrets gitignored and managed via vault
ActualResult: Supabase Service Role Key Redis DB password and Twilio keys exposed in plaintext
RootCause: Configuration files tracked in version control
Remediation: Revoke and rotate all cloud credentials; add .env to .gitignore immediately

Title: Frontend API Route Prefix Omission (404 Outage)
StepsToReproduce: Navigate to /leads/pool in browser and observe network tab.
RootCause: useLeadStore constructs URLs as ${API_URL}/leads where API_URL lacks /api/v1 prefix
Remediation: Prepend /api/v1 to all lead endpoints in useLeadStore.ts

Title: Command Center Analytics Route Returns 404 with Masked Fallbacks
StepsToReproduce: Navigate to /dashboard and inspect network traffic.
ActualResult: GET /dashboard/analytics returning 404; UI shows hardcoded 14 and 3 defaults
RootCause: Endpoint /dashboard/analytics is never registered in NestJS or Express backends
Remediation: Create NestJS controller for /api/v1/dashboard/analytics and align frontend store

Title: Inbound Vobiz Telephony Bridge Returns 'OK' Text Instead of XML
StepsToReproduce: Send simulated inbound call webhook to POST /vobiz/incoming.
ExpectedResult: Response with TwiML XML <Dial><Sip> livekit room
RootCause: handleVobizIncoming returns 'OK' text instead of calling vobizProvider.generateBridgeResponse
Remediation: Update handler to return vobizProvider.generateBridgeResponse() with proper XML

Title: Calendar and Appointments Route Prefix Inconsistencies
RootCause: Backend booking controller is mapped to /appointments/calendar without /api/v1 prefix
Remediation: Standardize BookingController to @Controller('api/v1/appointments') and align frontend paths

Title: Placeholder Modules with Dead Buttons
StepsToReproduce: Navigate to /marketing /automation /targets or /settings and click any action button.
ExpectedResult: Action persists data or triggers API workflow
ActualResult: Buttons perform no action or only mutate local React state
RootCause: Modules are static UI prototypes with zero backend integration
Remediation: Connect modules to Prisma database entities or disable dead buttons

Title: Tickets Table Mismatched Property Keys and Hardcoded Mock Array
ActualResult: Table shows 2 mock tickets with blank Customer and Subject columns
RootCause: tickets/page.tsx hardcodes mock array with customerName/title instead of customer/subject
Remediation: Remove mock array; fetch tickets from GET /api/v1/tickets and fix JSX property bindings

Title: Simulated Messaging in Omnichannel Main Application
ActualResult: Message status simulated locally via setTimeout
RootCause: handleSend lacks API call and uses local timeout simulation

Title: Invalid Gemini Model Name and Malformed API Key
StepsToReproduce: Trigger post-call AI analysis via generateCallSummary().
ExpectedResult: Audio transcribed and summarized by Gemini API
ActualResult: Pipeline throws 404 model not found and invalid API key error
RootCause: Non-existent model name 'gemini-3.8-flash' and invalid token string in .env
Remediation: Change model to gemini-2.5-flash and supply valid Google AI Studio key

Title: Dead Anchor Link on Login Form
ExpectedResult: Navigation to password recovery modal or route
ActualResult: Browser navigates to '#' with no action
RootCause: Anchor href set to '#' with no event handler
Remediation: Implement password reset flow or remove link until ready

Title: Unhandled Null Notes in Lead Conversion Triggers 500 Crash
ExpectedResult: Validation error or neutral sentiment assigned
ActualResult: Server crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toLowerCase')
RootCause: Direct invocation of notes.toLowerCase() without null check

Title: Missing Webhook Cryptographic Signature Verification
StepsToReproduce: Send POST to /vobiz/incoming or /webhook with forged payload.
RootCause: Webhooks do not verify HMAC SHA-256 signatures or provider tokens
Remediation: Verify provider HMAC signatures on all webhook endpoints

Title: Unauthenticated Agent Login on WebSocket Gateway
StepsToReproduce: Connect to ws://localhost:4000 and emit agent_login with any agentId.
ActualResult: Agent marked AVAILABLE and socket assigned
RootCause: WebSocketGateway accepts plain { agentId } without token verification
Remediation: Require valid JWT in handshake auth and verify user identity
